title: PyYAML arbitrary object instantiation via unsafe loader constructor inheritance
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0965: PyYAML arbitrary object instantiation via unsafe loader constructor inheritance
Repository: `yaml/pyyaml`
Category: `Security Sandbox & Serialization Exploits`
Target File: `lib/yaml/constructor.py`

#### Problem Description
Custom tag handler allows instantiation of arbitrary Python classes inheriting from object.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Restricted SafeLoader enforcing whitelist of primitive data types: dict, list, str, int, float, bool.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0965.py -q`
expected_invariant: Restricted SafeLoader enforcing whitelist of primitive data types: dict, list, str, int, float, bool.
